name: 고요한 추억
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity UX concept board for PhotosMCP, a private family photo STORY VIEWER, not a marketing website. Landscape 3:2. This is concept 01 "고요한 추억", Apple Photos Memories-inspired calm cinema, original product design. Main DESKTOP SCREEN fills left 78%, narrow MOBILE SCREEN right 22%, small diagram strip below both with three labeled states "감상 → 전체 사진 → 한 장 보기". Flat screens without laptop/device hardware. A charcoal almost-black canvas, restrained white typography, absolutely no bright interface colors. Dominant landscape photo completely visible uncropped inside generous black mat, candid fictional Korean family walking along a soft beige beach, beautiful authentic daylight photographs with natural muted colors. Compact top bar: back icon "스토리", small title "바다에서 보낸 하루", right "전체 사진" and share icon. Very small caption below photo, date "2026.09.06". Bottom neatly centered filmstrip of eight tiny varied beach photos with one white selection outline, "5 / 28", play icon, no busy toolbar. Photo must dominate, no large hero headline. Mobile shows same photo fitted without crop, black breathing room and short filmstrip; Android status and system navigation areas visible. Interaction strip includes a tiny gallery-grid state and a photo-fit state. Precision professional quiet layout, elegant spacing. No gradients, green accent, colored badges, metrics, admin sidebar, decorative glass, zoom +/- buttons or repeated arrows. High quality photo browsing UI. Labels legible Korean. Fictional sample photos, do not imitate real people from conversation.

name: 순간의 묶음
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. A high-fidelity original PhotosMCP family story UX design board, landscape 3:2, concept 02 "순간의 묶음". Inspired by Google Photos scrapbook-like Memories organization but NOT colorful stickers or branding. White/offwhite background, near-black quiet typography. Main desktop 75% width is a beautifully composed curated photo contact sheet organized into THREE distinct SCENE CLUSTERS, with asymmetric sizes and generous whitespace, NOT uniform repeated dashboard cards. Small top header "바다에서 보낸 하루" and "2026.09.06 · 28장", discreet "공유". Scene 01 "바다에 도착", large landscape coast image + two smaller portraits adjacent; scene 02 "함께 걷기", overlapping-edge print-style two photographs + one small square detail; scene 03 "돌아오는 길", quieter two sunset and cafe images. Each cluster grouped by tiny sequence number and caption outside image. Visible thumbnails fully natural, all fictional Korean family coastal outing photographs. Right 25% separate MOBILE DETAIL SCREEN: a selected scene opened into one tall photo story with four top segmented progress lines, top close icon, caption and bottom "2 / 6", neutral controls, phone status and home navigation visible. Lower small three-step strip: "장면 선택 → 사진 넘기기 → 목록으로". Layout is discovery by group then immersive photo sequence, unlike a single giant hero or dark filmstrip. NO rainbow, green theme, colored badges, giant titles, large cards with paragraphs, admin buttons, numerical scores, cute decorations, glossy glass. Crisp realistic workable UI, pleasing irregular editorial montage. This is a new concept mockup, not a copy of Google UI.

name: 스크롤 시네마
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally refined photo-led scroll storytelling web UX design board for PhotosMCP. Landscape 3:2, concept 03 "스크롤 시네마". Unlike photo grids or sliders: THREE connected sequential desktop scroll frames take most board width, at different page positions, with slim downward flow cues and a small mobile view at far right. Screen 1: nearly full frame uncropped beach arrival photo, thin top "PhotosMCP / Story", modest title "바다에서 보낸 하루" set in elegant Korean serif, date small. Screen 2: split layout, left 28% warm-white column with "02 함께 걷기" and short restrained paragraph "발걸음이 느려질수록 함께 보는 풍경이 많아졌다.", right 72% large fictional Korean family photograph walking by the sea, tiny vertical chapter markers in margin. Screen 3: photograph hands collecting shells with spacious white margin, short caption; a small route/location preview is below, not a distracting map dashboard. A horizontal bottom strip clearly labels "도착 → 산책 → 작은 발견". Visualize screenshot-like frames not a moodboard, demonstrate a continuous narrative tied to vertical scroll, photo and copy alternate without heavy overlay. Genuine documentary art direction, paper white, graphite type, color ONLY in natural soft beach photographs; no green UI, bright accent, gradients or excessive rounded cards. Main photo remains entirely readable, no faces hidden by text. Mobile view shows normal single-column scroll with photo then caption; status/nav bars. No auto-play indication, no huge heading, admin tabs, repeated CTA buttons or metrics. Original fictional family photos only. A sophisticated usable story article, clear calm cinematic progression.

name: 공간을 흐르는 사진
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a precise high-fidelity original 3D photo STORY GALLERY concept board for PhotosMCP, landscape 3:2, concept 04 "공간을 흐르는 사진". This is a concrete interaction design, NOT sci-fi concept art. Top 70% shows a large desktop web viewport with matte dark charcoal backdrop and a horizontal continuous curved ribbon of SEVEN thin rectangular photo planes in perspective. The CENTRAL photograph is large, PERFECTLY FLAT FRONT-FACING with no warp, a natural fictional Korean family walking on a beige beach, full photo visible. Adjacent photos trail toward background left and right along a shallow curved path, subtle perspective, realistic gentle depth and faint contact shadows, no literal film sprocket, no glowing ribbons. Images are landscapes, family candid portraits, seashell details, coast sunset. Photos occupy at least 70% viewport, central larger than others. Minimal top bar "바다에서 보낸 하루", "전체 사진", close icon. Bottom slim scene navigation "도착 — 산책 — 노을", current "5 / 28", modest hint "드래그해서 둘러보기". Below main viewport three clear small motion storyboard frames on white annotation band: 1 "둘러보기" shows curved planes; 2 "선택" selected photo turns straight and enlarges; 3 "편하게 감상" flat uncropped photo lightbox with bottom counter. Small mobile inset shows depth reduced to THREE cards and flat center, Android status/navigation present. Subtle neutral palette, natural photographs only colorful element. Center photo never hidden or twisted, no arbitrary camera tilt, no first-person controls, no particles, neon, bright green, giant typography, busy toolbar or +/- controls. Communicate elegant calm spatial scrolling and photo focus, practical web UI. Text legible Korean.

name: 펼쳐보는 기억의 책
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity distinct PhotosMCP story theme design board, landscape 3:2, concept 05 "펼쳐보는 기억의 책". Web-based dimensional PHOTOBOOK, NOT carousel, not grid dashboard, no spatial floating gallery. Main desktop viewport upper 70%: warm neutral light-gray background, a large open photobook seen almost straight-on with a very slight overhead angle. Realistic subtle paper thickness, center gutter, delicate physically plausible page shadow, premium matte ivory paper. Left page contains ONE large photograph fully on this page, fictional Korean mother and child collecting seashells on a beach, below a small caption. Right page contains two small candid travel photographs and restrained Korean story paragraph with modest serif heading "함께 걷던 오후". NO photograph crosses the center fold, preserve faces and image content. Small web navigation above book: "바다에서 보낸 하루" left, "목차" and share icon right. Below book simple "이전   06—07 / 24   다음". Bottom design strip shows THREE miniature book states with visible transition: "장면 읽기 → 책장 넘기기 → 사진 크게 보기"; middle frame has a gently curling turning page, last is FLAT dark photo-fit viewer. Separate narrow mobile inset at far right: SINGLE flat book page, photo + caption, swipe page navigation, status and bottom system bar visible. Photo color natural muted daylight, no sepia filters, no green accent, no stickers, no leather ornaments, no clutter, no vintage kitsch, no giant title, no table physical props or device hardware. Layout should feel like a real implementable family album website with subtle 3D paper mechanics and exceptionally clear reading hierarchy. Fictional sample photos only, legible Korean labels.
